policies.summary: The Public Utility Commission may not issue a certificate for a wind facility with any turbine taller than 350 feet sited on a mountain ridge above 2,500 feet elevation or 500 feet or more above the adjacent valley floor (single on-site turbines under 100 feet are exempt).
policies.statute_citation: Tenn. Code Ann. § 65-4-201 (subsection added by 2018 Tenn. Pub. Acts ch. 825, sec. 16)

policies.summary: Local wind legislation adopted under the state wind siting chapter must require turbines to be set back 3.5 times total height from a non-participating landowner's property line (waivable down to 1.1 times height) and to stay at or below 35 dBA at a non-participating dwelling and 45 dBA at the property line, with environmental and wildlife assessments and full decommissioning security.
policies.statute_citation: Tenn. Code Ann. 65-17-105(a), (e)(2)(A)-(G) (2018 Tenn. Pub. Acts ch. 825, sec. 5(a), (e)(1)(A)-(G))
